name: card-cube
title: Cube Rotation
description: Một khối lập phương sáu mặt (ảnh hoặc chữ) xoay đều quanh trục dọc, hơi nghiêng xuống để thấy mặt trên.

moworks.author: takayu

options.faces: the six faces: front, right, back, left, top, bottom
options.tilt: degrees toward the viewer (20; the site's demo about 29)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio 3d-cube, written here): CSS 3D cube, 6 faces (pictures or text), perspective about 1.1 x the frame width; rotateY 0 -> 360 deg over 4000 ms linear with a fixed rotateX 20 deg (demo ~29 deg), faces z-sorted, seamless loop. Params: period (4 s) · tilt (20°) · perspective (1.1 × khung).
